## Caasimolar (Former President of Hell) (CR 23)

**XP** 820,000  
LE Medium outsider (devil, evil, extraplanar, lawful)  
**Init** +12; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., detect magic, detect thoughts; Perception +43  


**Defense**


**AC** 47, touch 29, flat-footed 38 (+1 dodge, +8 Dex, +18 natural, +10 profane)  
**hp** 513 (27d10+243); regeneration 5 (good, silver)  
**Fort** +20, **Ref** +25, **Will** +26  
**DR** 15/good and silver; **Immune** fire, poison; **Resist** acid 10, cold 10; **SR** 34  


**Offense**


**Speed** 50 ft.  
**Melee** +3 cold iron good outsider bane quarterstaff +39/+34/+29/+24 (1d6+15 plus inflict moderate wounds)  
**Special Attacks** fear  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 20th)  

Constant—detect magic, detect thoughts (DC 22)  
At will—animate dead, blasphemy (DC 27), cone of cold (DC 25), detect good, greater dispel magic, greater teleport (self plus 50 pounds of objects only), invisibility (self only), magic circle against good, polymorph, tongues, true seeing, unholy aura (DC 28)  
3/day—wall of ice (DC 24), summon (level 9, 2d4 bearded devils 100% or 1 pit fiend 80%)  
1/day—power word kill  


**Tactics**


When first engaged in battle, Caasimolar uses his fear effect against all within range that can hear him. When encountered with his personal retinue of devils, he prefers to let them fight, while he hangs back and peppers the enemy with slay living effects (from his rod) or cones of cold.  

If his enemies force him into battle, he begins by releasing a slay living effect against who he deems to be the most powerful foe in the group. If this fails, he quickly unleashes a lightning bolt from his rod at the same target. If forced to fight close quarter, he relies on his rod’s physical power as well as its spell-like effects, and he utilizes his spell-like abilities. If the day is lost, Caasimolar summons devils to cover his escape before teleporting away to safety.  


**Statistics**


**Str** 27, **Dex** 26, **Con** 29, **Int** 29, **Wis** 29, **Cha** 30  
**Base Atk** +27; **CMB** +35; **CMD** 64  
**Feats** Alertness, Combat Reflexes, Combat Casting, Craft Wondrous Item, Critical Focus, Deceitful, Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Quicken Spell-Like Ability (cone of cold), Scribe Scroll, Weapon Focus (quarterstaff), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Dodgility.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +35, Bluff +44, Diplomacy +40, Disguise +44, Intimidate +40, Knowledge (arcana) +36, Knowledge (history) +39, Knowledge (local) +36, Knowledge (planes) +39, Knowledge (religion) +36, Perception +43, Sense Motive +43, Spellcraft +36, Stealth +38, Survival +36  
**Languages** Abyssal, Celestial, Common, Daemonic, Draconic, Giant, Goblin, Ignan, Infernal, Terran; telepathy 100 ft.  
**Gear** Caasimolar’s iron rod  


**Special Abilities**


**Fear (Su)** By speaking, Caasimolar induces fear in all creatures within 30 feet that hear him. Creatures within the area must succeed on a DC 33 Will save or be affected as if by a fear spell (CL 20th). If the save is successful, that creature cannot be affected again by Caasimolar’s fear for one day. Other devils are immune to the effect. The save DC is Charisma-based.  

**Unique Item: Caasimolar’s Iron Rod** This 6-foot long iron rod functions as a *+3 cold iron good outsider bane quarterstaff*.
